title: Adani Group to seek $1.5 billion for data center financing
description: Adani Group, led by Gautam Adani, is negotiating a $1.5 billion loan to finance its data center expansion. The joint venture AdaniConneX with EdgeConneX is involved in discussions with various lenders. Plans include investing around $100 billion in digital infrastructure by 2035, enhancing their energy business. Meanwhile, Reliance conglomerate is also investing significantly in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

title: Anthropic says revenue surged 1,100% ahead of IPO
description: Anthropic, one of the world's leading artificial intelligence companies, on Monday reported a more than 1,100 percent surge in quarterly revenue and nearly $900 billion in spending commitments as it counts down to its Wall Street listing later this month. The filing said the company has committed to spend about $895 billion, mostly on computing power, with $70 billion of that due before September 2027.

title: Wearable devices and AI provide early warning signs of hypertensive crises
description: Using artificial intelligence (AI) to analyze patterns in measures from a portable cuff-based blood pressure monitor and health data from a wrist-worn device may help identify when adults with stage 2 high blood pressure (blood pressure ≥140/90 mm Hg) are at increased risk of a dangerously high blood pressure episode (>180/120 mm Hg with acute end-organ damage), known as a hypertensive crisis, up to three days before it occurs, according to new, independent, preliminary research to be presented at the American Heart Association's Scientific Sessions 2026.
